card.title: 361. AFRIKA REGIMENT
card.text: When this unit moves into the frontline, deal 3 damage to the enemy HQ.
card.flavorText: The 361st Afrika Regiment was made up of 300 Germans who had served with the French Foreign Legion prior to WWII and despite being considered disreputable soldiers they were allowed to serve in the Wehrmacht due to the need for extra troops. The 361st Regiment was part of the 90th Light Infantry Division of the Wehrmacht Afrika Corp and served in North Africa, Sardinia and Italy. The division played a major role in the North African Campaign where it fought against the British 8th Army, but after the Tunisian Campaign in 1943 it surrendered to the Allies. The division was reorganized that same year and deployed in Sardinia and later moved to Italy where it was listed as destroyed in 1944.
